entry.title: Maiden's Tower
entry.note: Native+X follows the mapped north-northwest fort axis; native+Z faces east-northeast. Heading1.721295251 places west pavilion, north court entry and newly reopened east Fatih doorway on their published sides. Tower center averages the four actual shaft corners. Historic roof polygons are map controls, not the restored open courtyard. Medium-fi restored2023 daylight exterior: actual mapped6.4m shaft and fort/pavilion plan control horizontal placement;32.5m mast envelope, arch heights, timber covertways, roof/coping and ornament details are proportional reconstruction from official restoration text/illustrations. The homepage courtyard image is an architectural illustration, not a survey photograph. Closed old roof polygons are not recreated after2023 courtyard reopening. Exact masonry, curved profiles, Fatih doorway shape, full visitor/internal routes, flag cloth, night laser show and underground reinforcement are outside this architectural exterior scope. Host terrain supplies inhabited island height; no artificial water offset or footprint replacement. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
